
        <h2 class="post-title">
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/issac-wan/p/23694784" title="发布于 2026-11-17 15:38">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SEGGER_RTT 打印</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="segger_rtt">SEGGER_RTT</h1>
<p><img alt="image-20261116113917749" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116113917749.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>J-Link支持通过调试接口进行RTT（Real Time Transfer）打印，<code>RTT</code>默认实现是每个方向使用一个通道，该通道用于可打印的终端输入和输出。</p>
<p>使用<code>J-Link RTT Viewer</code>，该通道可用于多个 “虚拟” 终端，从而仅使用一个目标缓冲区即可打印到多个窗口（例如，一个用于标准输出，一个用于错误输出，一个用于调试输出）。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>[!NOTE]</p>
<p>RTT 只操作 RAM 中的环形缓冲区，数据由 J-Link 通过 SWD 调试口直接读取，只要J-Link 访问CPU的 RAM即可，不依赖任何内核特性与外设</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>唯一与内核相关的是带 Cache 的核（如 Cortex-A、ESP32）需配置<code>SEGGER_RTT_UNCACHED_OFF</code> 保证读写一致性</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>上行缓冲区 (Target -&gt; Host)</strong>——打印</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>写入指针</strong>由Target写入，<strong>读取指针</strong>由调试探针 (J-Link、Host) 写入。当读取和写入指针指向同一个元素时，缓冲区为空（ring buffer）</p>
<blockquote>
<p>对 MCU 来说只是一次内存拷贝，不涉及任何通信外设。</p>
</blockquote>
<ul>
<li><strong>下行缓冲区 (Host-&gt; Target)</strong>——接收主机输入：方向相反，J-Link 写入、MCU 轮询读取。</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image-20261116135745939" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116135745939.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>平均一行文本打印时间仅需<code>1us</code>（<em>STM32F407 Cortex-M4 running at 168 MHz</em>）</p>
<p><img alt="image-20261116140602477" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116140602477.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="mdk使用方法">MDK使用方法</h2>
<p>安装<a href="https://www.segger.com/downloads/jlink/JLink_Windows.exe" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">J-Link</a>后，安装目录下包含<strong><code>RTT</code>源码</strong>： <code>..\SEGGER\JLink\Samples\RTT</code></p>
<p>MDK配置如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>添加文件</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image-20261116143158566" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116143158566.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>添加文件路径</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image-20261116143120957" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116143120957.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="segger_rtt_printf">SEGGER_RTT_printf</h2>
<p><code>int SEGGER_RTT_printf(unsigned BufferIndex, const char * sFormat, ...)</code></p>
<ul>
<li><code>BufferIndex</code>：写入的上行缓冲区通道编号（<code>_SEGGER_RTT.aUp[n]</code>），0 为默认Terminal</li>
</ul>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>缓冲区通道数量</strong>由<code>SEGGER_RTT_Conf.h</code> 的<code>SEGGER_RTT_MAX_NUM_UP_BUFFERS</code> 宏决定，未初始化的缓冲区，需先<code>SEGGER_RTT_ConfigUpBuffer</code> 分配内存</p>
</blockquote>
<p><code>J-Link RTT Viewer</code>软件的的 Terminal窗口：</p>
<p><img alt="image-20261116130929302" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116130929302.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li><code>sFormat</code>：格式化字符串，支持 ANSI 转义 （<em>仅<code>Terminal 0</code>支持 ANSI 转义，可实现<strong>彩色日志</strong></em>）</li>
</ul>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>类型</th>
<th>转义序列</th>
<th>颜色</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>错误</td>
<td><code>\033[31m</code></td>
<td><span style="color: rgba(232, 70, 58, 1)"><strong>红</strong></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>警告</td>
<td><code>\033[33m</code></td>
<td><span style="color: rgba(239, 170, 23, 1)"><strong>黄</strong></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>正常</td>
<td><code>\033[32m</code></td>
<td><span style="color: rgba(29, 201, 129, 1)"><strong>绿</strong></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>信息</td>
<td><code>\033[36m</code></td>
<td><span style="color: rgba(39, 210, 191, 1)"><strong>青</strong></span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>恢复默认</td>
<td><code>\033[0m</code></td>
<td>-</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<pre><code class="language-c">#define LOG_E(fmt, ...) SEGGER_RTT_printf(0, "\033[31m"fmt"\033[0m", ##__VA_ARGS__)
#define LOG_W(fmt, ...) SEGGER_RTT_printf(0, "\033[33m"fmt"\033[0m", ##__VA_ARGS__)
#define LOG_I(fmt, ...) SEGGER_RTT_printf(0, "\033[32m"fmt"\033[0m", ##__VA_ARGS__)
#define LOG_D(fmt, ...) SEGGER_RTT_printf(0, "\033[36m"fmt"\033[0m", ##__VA_ARGS__)
</code></pre>
<p><mark>注</mark>：</p>
<ul>
<li>打印完需恢复默认<code>\033[0m</code>，否则会影响后续其他日志输出样式</li>
<li><code>SEGGER_RTT_printf</code>调用前<strong>无需显式初始化</strong>，其仅首次调用会执行 <code>INIT()</code>初始化，且不依赖外设</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="j-link-rtt-viewer">J-Link RTT Viewer</h2>
<ul>
<li>连接J-Link</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image-20261116113816634" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116113816634.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li>输出效果</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image-20261116150429207" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116150429207.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code class="language-c">SEGGER_RTT_printf(0, "cnt = %d\n",cnt++); //RTT打印
LOG_E("EER! ");	  LOG_W("WARN! ");	LOG_I("INFO! ");	LOG_D("DEBUG!\n");	
</code></pre>
<p><kbd>ALT + R</kbd>可清空显示</p>
<p>J-Link RTT Viewer软件<strong>不支持中文显示</strong>，可使用开源的<strong><a href="https://github.com/MisakaMikoto128/mini-rtt-viewer" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">mini-rtt-viewer</a></strong>：</p>
<p><img alt="image-20261117110409342" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261117110409342.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>此外，还支持本地日志<code>.log</code>导出保存（<strong>自动过滤颜色转义符号</strong>）：</p>
<p><img alt="image-20261117112659692" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261117112659692.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="j-link-rtt-client--logger">J-Link RTT Client &amp; Logger</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>J-Link RTT Client</strong>：连接 RTT Viewer/Server 的 TCP 端口（19021），实时旁听<strong>显示 RTT 输出（支持中文）</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image-20261116172047664" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116172047664.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>J-Link RTT Logger</strong>：自带 DLL 会话直接读 RTT，把上行数据持续<strong>写入文件</strong>（记录日志用，不依赖 RTT Viewer）</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="image-20261116164503089" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116164503089.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>文件默认保存路径：<code>%APPDATA%\SEGGER</code>（可指定如：<code>D:\log\rtt.log</code>）</p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>转义符号</strong>不识别</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img alt="image-20261116164612110" loading="lazy" data-src="https://issac-wan.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/img/image-20261116164612110.png" class="lazyload"></p>
